markets.rules_primary: If the signed one-month percent change in the seasonally adjusted Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers: All Items less Food and Energy for July 2022, as published by the Bureau of Labor Statistics, is greater than 0.8%, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Please note that the value of the Underlying is the single-decimal value reported by the BLS.

The market will expire at the sooner of the first 10:00 AM following the release of the data, or one week following the scheduled release of the data (scheduled for August 10, 2022). The market will always close on 8:25 AM on the scheduled day of the data release (August 10, 2022).
